svg.text: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform — End-to-End Agent Evaluation & Quality Flywheel
ADK 2.13 (gemini-3.8-flash) | agentplatform.Client.evals | User Simulation | Metric Registry | Loss Clusters | OnlineEvaluator + Drift Alerts
• Exports inference events to Cloud Trace
2. Cold-Start User Simulation & Golden Trace Capture (agentplatform.Client.evals)
• Introspects agent instructions & tool schemas via AgentInfo.load_from_agent(root_agent)
• Generates realistic Starting Prompts + hidden multi-turn User Simulator Conversation Plans
Use agentplatform.Client (vertexai.Client is deprecated in google-cloud-aiplatform >= 2.7.0).
Golden Regression + Multi-Turn User Simulator Inference
• Curated golden_eval_cases.json (spend audits, severity rules, missing-justification traps)
• Multi-turn User Simulator roleplays follow-ups (user_simulator_config: max_turn=4)
• Captures immutable intermediate_events (tool calls, args, outputs) + final responses
3. Metric Registry, Rubric Autoraters & Loss Cluster Triage
Adaptive rubrics auto-tailor pass/fail checks per prompt + AgentInfo; Hallucination verifies atomic claims vs tool outputs.
Reusable Custom Metrics in Metric Registry (evaluationMetrics/*)
• Custom LLMMetric: finops_policy_citation_compliance (verifies POL-* policy ID citations)
• Custom CodeExecutionMetric: finops_audit_id_format_hygiene (deterministic QTA-*/REM-* regex check)
Registered once via client.evals.create_evaluation_metric(); reused across CI runs & experiments.
Automatic Loss Cluster Analysis & Managed EvaluationRun
• global_client.evals.generate_loss_clusters() groups failures into Google Loss Taxonomies
• client.evals.create_evaluation_run() + EvaluationExperiment persisted to GCS & Console UI
Gotcha: generate_loss_clusters() is global-only; initialize a separate Client(location="global").
Gotcha: ALIGN_MEAN is rejected for DISTRIBUTION
User Simulation, Custom Registry Metrics & CI Ship Gate
OTel GenAI v1.39+, Loss Clusters & Drift Alerts
